abstract: Exact scaled stationary radius has the law of a product of two independent gamma variables; the spatial equilibrium density has a sharp reset-point modality transition at sluggishness alpha=d-2 and a dimension-independent near-reset small-ball exponent alpha+2.
scientific_integrity: An analytic radial-generator proof is supplied. Classical Bessel and gamma laws are used as established ingredients. The finite numerical checks are diagnostics, not a substitute for the proof. No external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the time-changed-Brownian Itô realization in dimensions d>=3 with alpha>0, homogeneous rate of point resetting, and homogeneous isotropic radial power-law diffusivity. Claims of originality retain possible implicit-derivation risk.
title: Gamma-product equilibrium and the reset-site mode transition
